verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to automate and execute workflows in the repository, and Copilot cloud agent works autonomously on assigned tasks. The cloud agent researches the repo, plans, makes changes on a branch and opens PRs, with a central page for monitoring agent sessions and task assignment possible from mobile. missing for 10: detail on how automations are triggered or scheduled (events, cron) to run unattended, a way to schedule recurring autonomous agent runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of background autonomous operation.
